verdict.rationale: Xero's JAX assistant explicitly lets users create, edit, and send invoices via plain-language commands and lets JAX categorize/match bank reconciliation transactions, directly matching the natural-language command story. However, this natural-language interface appears limited to invoicing and reconciliation rather than the full product surface (reports, bills, contacts, multi-currency, etc.), and there's no independent/hands-on corroboration of JAX's real-world reliability. missing for 10: evidence of natural-language commands covering broader Xero functionality (reporting, bill pay, contact management), independent user validation of JAX's accuracy/robustness.
